prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, landscape, not a finished book page. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-ZOE / Zoe: six-year-old human girl, deep brown skin, black hair in two puffs, yellow T-shirt, plum overalls, white sneakers. The ONLY named human protagonist is Zoe. Kit MUST NOT appear. Ignore every other child shown in reference sheets; unnamed adults may appear only when this scene explicitly requires them. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: One More Use; World Discovery; fiction.
Setting: Zoe’s bedroom on a clean rug beside a low shelf, afternoon. Bear is always visibly a stuffed toy.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): One plain brown clean shoebox 30 cm long, no lid or writing; One small tan stuffed bear with stitched black eyes, no clothing, about 20 cm tall; One folded blue cloth large enough to line and cover the bear
 Create a clean separated reference board on white: show the principal recurring props/animals in front, side and three-quarter views, their relative scale beside any named human cast, and a single simple location key showing the persistent setting and daylight/palette. The human character model sheet is a supporting identity reference, not content to copy wholesale. Show only the subjects this book requires. Use initial object states: Box empty and unlined; bear and cloth separate.. For orientation, the opening location/action is: Zoe holds an empty plain brown shoebox above her rug; tan stuffed bear and folded blue cloth rest separately nearby.. Do not show a completed craft or later scene merely because the finished object is listed in design locks. No future story events, no captions.
Strict board scope: do not invent additional human cast, unrelated animals or objects. Show no story events after the initial state. The reference is for exact subjects specified above only; no copying irrelevant content from any cast reference.

visualReview.note: Directly viewed Zoe-only model, plain open brown shoebox, one tan stitched bear, one blue cloth and neutral bedroom. Opening model leaves bear/cloth outside; scale supports box bed.
visualReview.limits: Direct agent image and sequence inspection; no classroom or physical-device observation.
